metaDescription: Portfolio of Derek W. Warner-Reyes, Senior Fullstack Software Engineer.
bioContent:
Senior Fullstack software engineer experienced in building, testing, and maintaining web and mobile applications from conception to production. Most recently served as lead fullstack software engineer at Olio Apps from 2021-2026.

In my free time I enjoy reading, writing, playing saxophone, cycling, and going to concerts. I'm also a passionate home chef, loving uncle, and I enjoy supporting my community through local activism and volunteer work.
name: Derek W. Warner-Reyes
